name: DocuFlow Studio Pro
author: Burhanuddin Sounasath
description:
## 🚀 DocuFlow Studio Pro 2026
Universal Document Fusion, Vector Engineering, and Offline PDF Workstation for the Anything Ecosystem.

### ✨ Core Creative & Conversion Suites:
- **PDFella-Grade PDF Editor**: In-place text editing, live freehand pen drawings, digital signature pad, whiteout redaction, shapes, stamps, and page manager sidebar.
- **Heterogeneous Universal Fusion**: Stagger and fuse arbitrary multi-format documents (Word, Excel, AutoCAD DWG/DXF, Images, Text, PDFs) into one unified master publication.
- **PDF Page Studio & Visual Splitter**: Interactive thumbnail canvas to drag-reorder pages, rotate 90°, exclude unwanted sheets, extract custom page ranges (e.g., 1-3, 5), or split all pages into a ZIP archive.
- **Office to PDF & 1-to-1 Batch Engine**: Convert Microsoft Word (.docx) and Excel (.xlsx, .xls) files directly into separate individual PDFs with native folder saving or ZIP exports.
- **AutoCAD CAD-to-Blueprint Studio**: Parse AutoCAD DWG and DXF vector drawings into CAD blueprints with Architectural Blueprint, Monochrome, and Layer Color themes up to A1 sheet size.
- **Image-to-PDF Gallery Studio**: High-res JPG/PNG/WEBP rearrangement with orientation and margin presets.
- **PDF Reverse Exporters & Offline OCR Vision**: Deconstruct PDFs into editable Word (.docx), Excel (.xlsx), 300 DPI page images (.zip), plain text, or perform local OCR on scanned documents via Tesseract.
- **Security, Watermarking & Smart Compressor**: Diagonal copyright stamps, dynamic page numbering, document compression profiles, and user password protection.
- **In-App Instant PDF Previewer**: Inspect rendered documents on-screen with zoom and rotation before saving.
